partWhy.COMPANY_LEGAL: On the letterhead and in the legal line of every page (c.c. art. 2250).
partWhy.NUMBER_AND_DATE: As the number series issued them.
partWhy.PARTY: Name, address and tax identity as kept on the record.
partWhy.FACTS: What the document records, such as a DDT's transport (DPR 472/1996).
partWhy.TOTALS: Computed from the lines; no template changes them.
partWhy.NOTICES: Words the law or the document needs, such as the courtesy copy's notice.
partWhy.SIGNATURES: The driver's, the carrier's and the recipient's boxes.

service.status_changed: When a person moves a case and its customer mail is switched on.

shipping.tracking_link: When a shipment's tracking link is sent to the customer.

refusal.NOT_A_DRAFT: This version was published: its words never change. Start a new version.
refusal.NOT_IN_USE: Only the version in use can be retired.
refusal.DRAFT_OPEN: A draft of this template is already open: open that one, or delete it first.
refusal.ANOTHER_IN_USE: Another version was published at the same time: the template was read again.
refusal.VERSION_TAKEN: Another version was written at the same time: the template was read again.
refusal.NOT_OFFERED: This template is not one Nexus reads.
refusal.DATABASE: The template cannot be changed like this: it was read again.

problem.invalid: The words were refused as they are: check each field.

section.totals: Totals and what it always prints
section.subject: Subject

field.subject: Subject

field.bodyHint: As you write it, line by line; placeholders are filled when the mail goes out.

lines.droppedSaved: {columns}: not a column of this document; it does not print.

parts.intro: Every document of this kind prints these, whatever its template says.

use.allWins: Used by every company that has no version of its own.
